title: Southern Breeze | KEY.co
meta_description: Within an easy stroll of Rosemary Beach
description_expanded: Tucked away in the charming coastal community of Inlet Beach, Southern Breeze blends classic Southern charm with relaxed Gulf Coast luxury. This expansive three-story retreat offers over 4,300 square feet of beautifully designed living space, including five bedrooms, a private carriage house, and room for up to eighteen guests. Inside, inviting gathering spaces, a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, and thoughtfully designed sleeping areas create the perfect setting for both lively family moments and quiet relaxation. Balconies and a rooftop terrace reveal sweeping Gulf views, while elegant interiors and comfortable furnishings elevate every stay. Outdoor living is just as exceptional, with a large heated pool, summer kitchen, and private fenced backyard designed for sun-filled afternoons and memorable evenings under the stars. A separate carriage house provides additional privacy with its own kitchen, living area, and poolside balcony. With beach access just down Winston Lane, a six-seater golf cart, and adult bikes included, exploring the nearby sugar-white sands and the shops and restaurants of Rosemary Beach is effortless. Every detail of this coastal haven is designed to inspire connection, comfort, and unforgettable beachside memories.
